items.t: Why Is Hasbro (HAS) Moving Its Headquarters To Boston?
items.sum: Hasbro (NasdaqGS:HAS) disclosed plans to shift its corporate headquarters from Pawtucket, Rhode Island, to Boston, Massachusetts. Local officials in Rhode Island publicly criticized the relocation, citing concerns about employment, tax revenue, and the loss of a long standing corporate resident.
